Major League Baseball is looking for an Associate Software Engineer (Seasonal) in the Baseball and Content Engineering (BACE) organization to build the code that powers the baseball experience on MLB.com. Launched in 2001 as the tech arm of Major League Baseball, MLB.com is renowned for creating experiences that baseball fans love, and by embracing modern, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-augmented development practices, we're building the future of sports technology faster than ever. Our BACE organization distributes content from our Content Management System (CMS) to MLB, MiLB, and other operated properties. This includes managing the publishing pipelines for news, videos, and push notifications, as well as services that support sitemap generation, search functionality, and cache busting. Additionally, we support internal tools that enable digital producers to create and manage forms for both MLB and MiLB Clubs. We also maintain a tool for managing player photo uploads, marketing materials, walk-up songs, and vanity redirects. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with other world-class engineers, product developers, and designers; contribute to award-winning, complex apps and systems; influence the innovation of products used by millions globally; and work in a highly collaborative, results-oriented team environment.
